content.value: A drum of radius 90 mm is mounted on a cylinder of radius 120 mm as shown in figure below. A cord is wound around the drum and is pulled in such a way that point D has a velocity 90 mm/s and an acceleration of 450 mm $/ s ^ { 2 }$ both directed to left. Assuming the cylinder rolls without sliding, determine the acceleration of i) of point A and ii) of point C.
